attchmntText: Nupur Recyclers Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: Nupur Recyclers Limited has uploaded the audio recording of the conference call with investors and analysts held on November 16, 2026. The recording is available on the company website at the provided link. This filing is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI LODR Regulations. The company previously intimated this event on November 11, 2026. The audio file can be accessed via the URL shared in the submission. Shilpa Verma, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, signed the communication. The NSE symbol is NRL and the ISIN is INE0JM501013.

attchmntText: Nupur Recyclers Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Nupur Recyclers Limited filed an investor presentation regarding financial results for the second quarter of 2026-27 ended on 30th September 2026. The company reported total revenue of 11,620.80 Lakh rupees, up 124.86 percent year-on-year, and profit after tax of 879.84 Lakh rupees. Management commentary highlighted strong performance driven by higher volumes in the non-ferrous scrap business and growing subsidiary contributions. Capacity expansion is underway, including a 6,000 MTPA Lithium Iron Phosphate battery recycling facility at Sampla, Haryana, and additional aluminium extrusion capacity at Frank Metals and Nupur Extrusion. These projects are funded through internal accruals and are targeted for commissioning in the fourth quarter of 2026-27. The presentation is available on the company website at www.nupurrecyclers.com.

attchmntText: Nupur Recyclers Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Nupur Recyclers Limited has published the extract of its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and Half Year ended September 30, 2026. The announcement was made on November 13, 2026. The extract was published in the Financial Express in English and Jansatta in Hindi. The documents are also available on the company website at www.nupurrecyclers.com. This filing is pursuant to Regulation 30 and 47 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The company secretary and compliance officer, Shilpa Verma, signed the communication to the National Stock Exchange.
